name: Automatic backup
description: Backs up your printer's configuration on a schedule, so a factory reset, a failed firmware update or a mistake in printer.custom.cfg is easy to undo. Each backup is a small .tar.gz file with printer.custom.cfg, the stock printer and bed mesh settings (printer_mutable.cfg), Moonraker and Boomslang settings, your app settings and, optionally, the Moonraker database with print history and Spoolman spool assignments. Backups go to a USB drive plugged into the printer (in a boomslang-backups folder) or to any folder you choose, for example a NAS share mounted with the NFS Mount app. The oldest backups are deleted once there are more than you want to keep. No backup is taken while printing; it waits until the print is done. The web portal password is never included. Uses no memory between backups.

folder.display: Backup folder (when saving to a folder)

include_database.display: Include print history and Spoolman assignments

backup_on_start.display: Back up a few minutes after the printer starts
